obligations.note: markDocumentReceived changes state: it marks the document received and saves the case. The diff replaces its audit.record(actor, EDIT_CASE, caseId, ...) call with a log.info line, so this operation no longer records an audit event with actor, action, target and time. The AUD-1 control test is only a sample and passing it does not cover this path.
The one new log call site (log.info) logs only a DocumentType enum value and the case id. Neither is NPI. The sampled LOG-1 control test is listed as passing.
No exception in the register covers AUD-1 for mortgage.cases, so the AUD-1 deviation is not excused. EXC-0167 is for LOG-1/mortgage.logging and EXC-0172 is withdrawn.
Ticket CHG-24651 is a standard ticket, approved 2026-10-09 by Grace Kim (change_manager) before review. Its component mortgage.cases covers CaseService.java.
Wen Li (change_approver for baseline-mortgage) gave the code_review approval. She is a different person from the author, Nneka Okafor.
The approval names the head commit c6e2c916, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json claims success on the head commit from ci-runner-08 starting 2026-10-12. The attached JUnit reports, however, come from host dev-laptop-7.local with timestamp 2026-10-23, which is after the review time. It is therefore unclear that these reports belong to this CI run on the final commit.
The only touched component is mortgage.cases, which is not security_sensitive, so no security review is required.
No protected paths (controls data, control tests, CI) are changed, so no control_owner approval is needed.
The ticket is standard, not emergency, so no post-implementation review is due.
No ledger entry covers CaseService.java. The entries for Approvals, Underwriting, Policy and payments code are unaffected by this change.

summary: The change removes the audit event from markDocumentReceived, a state-changing operation, and replaces it with an application log line. This violates AUD-1, and no exception in the register covers the deviation. The ticket, the independent approval and approval-on-head are in order. The CI reports, however, look like they come from a local machine at a date after the review time. The change is rejected because of the AUD-1 violation.
